blind.description: A stylized fantasy bust of a Green Man or nature spirit, featuring a serene bearded face formed from overlapping green oak leaves with yellowish highlights. Two small brown wooden antlers branch out from the temples. The head rests atop a cylindrical, circular stone masonry pedestal adorned with carved leaf runes/shields and mossy crevices. All geometry is solid, continuous, and stylized with clean hand-painted texturing, resting flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it displays the layered, stepped ridges of the foliage head with two prominent antler tines extending horizontally to the left and right, sitting centered over the rounded circular stone base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 60% of the figure's height (around 3.5 feet tall) and roughly half as wide as the figure is tall.

notes: Antler span makes overall footprint wider than the 2:1 catalog aspect ratio
